evidence_excerpts: (3) By (2) and essence, there are essential truths about [p], D, the plurality consisting of [p] and D, or the entities they involve according to which ∧D → p. (4) The essential truths are metaphysically necessary. (5) By (3) and (4), 0(∧D → p).
text: Because essential truths are metaphysically necessary, the significance and essence principles together imply the modal necessity of full grounding.
